[[File:Naboo_crest.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Naboo crest]] made of orichalc]]
'''Orichalc''' was a [[Gold/Legends|gold]]-like metal [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|423|orichalc}}</ref> The [[Naboo crest]] headdress of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was made of orichalc.<ref name="TCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> A sphere of pure orichalc was part of [[Catalog Nineteen]], a catalog of rare items collected by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] since the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CN1">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>

{{Substance-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In reality, orichalc is a yellow metal prized in ancient times, probably a form of [[Wikipedia:brass|brass]] or a similar [[Wikipedia:alloy|alloy]], although some writers treated it as a fabulous metal.<ref> [[Wikipedia: The Oxford Dictionary of Phrase and Fable|The Oxford Dictionary of Phrase and Fable]] via http://www.encyclopedia.com/doc/1O214-orichalc.html</ref>
